name: SickCallVisit
title: Sick Call Visit
description: HiiveHealth-style Sick Call visit template with checklist tasks for Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan sections.

action.title: Record and document vitals, height, weight
action.description: Capture vital signs including temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, SpO2, height, and weight.

action.title: Complete HPI and ROS
action.description: Complete History of Present Illness and Review of Systems.

action.title: Conduct PE, assessment/diagnosis and treatment plan
action.description: Conduct physical exam, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment plan.

action.title: Duty restrictions or activity modifications placed in system/SF 600
action.description: Document patient disposition and any duty restrictions.

action.title: Follow up instructions and appointment scheduled
action.description: Provide follow-up instructions and schedule any required appointments.
